notes.title: Caffeine: Victoria's Legacy - ALL Routes Now Available
notes.content:
Yesterday, we just uploaded our last major build onto Steam. The game is now completed, with all routes now accessible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33313285/429d53bac38f4972d5ecd0e767557c3dfbe03974.png[/img]

The game now contains:

[list]
[*] A 25-hour epic story about coffee, romance, family and intrigue.
[*] Includes 21 Steam Achievements
[*] Four Romanceable Routes and One True Ending Route which unlocks after finishing 3 out of 4 routes.
[*] 78 High-Resolution CGs  and a dozen Animated Scenes
[*] Over 2000+ voice lines during introduction and CG scenes
[/list]

If you have already brought the Early Access version of the game, you will now have the Full Version available to you once you've updated the game on Steam. We will announce an Official Full Release Date in the coming days.

notes.title: Caffeine: Victoria's Legacy is now available on Early Access!
notes.content:
Caffeine: Victoria's Legacy is now available on Early Access. 

What's the difference between the Early Access Version and Full Release? 

[list]
[*] The Early Access Version contains completed Eliza, Mel and Oceane routes. Alice's route is also accessible pending a few CGs.
[*]True Ending ends in a cliffhanger. The story will be continued once the content is available.
[*] The credits screen is missing. 
[*] Steam achievements haven't been set up yet.
[*] The Mac version is available in 64 bit, but isn't notarized yet. 
[/list]

But overall, the game is definitely playable for at least 20 hours, with hundreds of choices available, allowing you to navigate the different branches and interesting dialogues in the story. 90% of the CGs are also available.

We are excited to hear from you once you have had a chance to play the game. In fact, this is something we definitely would like your help. Please review our game if you have the time to go through our game. 

As you know, this is our debut visual novel, we are a small studio with a limited marketing budget, and the only way to get more visibility on Steam is if backers like you could offer your generous feedback towards our game. 

Thank you, enjoy your play!
